gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: abdominal pain. Generated cc-001: severe lower abdominal pain. Same core complaint; generated adds severity/location.

Gold: constant periumbilical pain that is worsening. Generated hpi-002 and hpi-003: constant lower abdominal pain below belly button in midline, worsening over past few days. Same concept of constant, periumbilical/lower midline, and worsening.
Gold: pain severity 8/10. Generated hpi-004: pain rated 8/10. Direct match.
Gold: light per vaginal bleeding. Generated hpi-005: episodes of light vaginal bleeding. Same, with extra descriptive detail.
Gold: some difficulty passing urine. Generated notes reduced frequency and lack of pain/blood/odor (hpi-021–023, ros-013) but does not mention difficulty passing urine (voiding difficulty).

Gold: daily bowel movements, normal stool. Generated hpi-019: bowel movements are normal at time of consult; implies currently normal though not explicitly 'daily'. Close enough conceptually that current BMs are normal.

Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated hpi-006 and hpi-020, ros-004: constipation last week/occasional constipation improved this week. Same episode, though generated hedges with 'occasional'.
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-007: last normal menstrual period 2–3 weeks ago. Same general timing with a slightly broader range.
Gold: last foreign travel 1 year ago. Generated sh-004: abroad approximately a year ago. Same fact.

Gold: denies dysuria/frequency. Generated hpi-021, hpi-022, ros-013: no abnormal urinary symptoms except possibly reduced frequency and no pain/odor/blood. This is compatible, though gold explicitly says no frequency change while generated allows 'possibly reduced frequency'; still broadly capturing denial of dysuria and most urinary symptoms.
Gold: denies any additional PV discharge. Generated ros-006: reports minimal vaginal discharge. This is opposite (see gen ros-006 as contradiction), so the gold denial is not captured as such.
Gold: eating and drinking ok. Generated hpi-018: reports normal eating and drinking. Direct match.

Gold: has not checked temperature and does not feel feverish. Generated only documents denial of fever (ros-007, hpi-012), not the fact that temperature was not checked or the subjective 'does not feel feverish.' So this specific detail is not captured.
Gold: not feeling faint. Generated hpi-014 and ros-012: denies faintness/dizziness. Same concept.
Gold: denies SOB or shoulder tip pain. Generated hpi-015, ros-010: denies dyspnea (difficulty breathing); hpi-016, ros-011: denies shoulder pain. Same content, minus 'tip' qualifier.
Gold: reports nausea. Generated hpi-011 and ros-002: feels nauseated. Same.

Gold: takes no regular medications. Generated lists only Implanon as a device/medication; does not state 'no regular medications.'

Gold: allergic to amoxicillin. Generated allergy-001 and asm-006: amoxicillin allergy. Same, with added note of missing reaction details.
Gold: works as teacher. Generated sh-001: school teacher. Same.
Gold: has been able to work as usual. Generated social history does not state functional status or ability to work as usual.
Gold: lives with husband and his family. Generated sh-002: lives with husband and husband's family. Same.

Gold: get in touch earlier if pain worse/new sx. Generated plan-003 and fu-002: seek medical advice/clinic/ER sooner if pain worsens or symptoms escalate. Same follow-up trigger.
